column1: # A 272-pair run WITH 1m peaked at 11.54GB RSS against 0.70GB MemAvailable and was
# OOM-killed 5 times across two attempts, always cutting off mid-log with no error.
# Both arms drop 1m together, so the DELTA within universe 2 stays valid; only the
# absolute tail figures get coarser, because exits are then evaluated on 5m bounds.
# Kept separate from the u2- results and never compared arm-to-arm across universes,
# since universe 1 has 1m detail and this does not.
